title: CE21003: Hydraulics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic properties of water; Determination of hydrostatic forces; Kinematics of
flow; Potential flow; Continuity, Energy and Momentum principles; Open channel
flow; Uniform and gradually varied flows; Dimensional analysis; Hydraulic
similitude and Modelling; Flow in pipes and Pipe networks; Hydraulics machines;
Pumps and Turbines.
